comment:
* GnssStatus representation that works across all Android versions. See {@link GnssStatus} and * {@link GpsStatus}. * *

Note: When used to wrap {@link GpsStatus}, the best performance can be obtained by using a * monotonically increasing {@code satelliteIndex} parameter (for instance, by using a loop from * 0 to {@link #getSatelliteCount()}). Random access is supported but performance may suffer.

methods.name: public static GnssStatusCompat wrap(@NonNull GnssStatus gnssStatus)
methods.comment: * Wraps the given {@link GnssStatus} as GnssStatusCompat.

methods.name: public static GnssStatusCompat wrap(@NonNull GpsStatus gpsStatus)
methods.comment: * Wraps the given {@link GpsStatus} as GnssStatusCompat.

methods.comment:

     * @param satelliteIndex A index from zero to {@link #getSatelliteCount()} - 1
